Definition: from an absolute πός (who, what) and G3739; interrogative pronoun (of amount) how much (large, long or (plural) many):--how great (long, many), what.
BiblicalUsage: Posos asks how much, how great, how many. Paul asks what carefulness godly sorrow wrought in the Corinthians, and Luke says how many thousands of Jews have believed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God counts what we cannot, and the thousands who believe are his answer to every small beginning.
